notes: SQL has no single runtime: pick the engine per project (SQLite for local, PostgreSQL for server). Never run generated SQL against a production database; test on a copy or a local database first. Migrations run in order, once.

run.command: sqlite3 app.db < schema.sql (SQLite) or psql -d app < schema.sql (PostgreSQL)

runtime.install: sqlite3 (built-in on most systems) or PostgreSQL 15+
runtime.name: SQLite 3 / PostgreSQL 15+

test.command: run the query file against a fresh test database and compare output
